name: newcastle-core-v1
description: Provisional initial Newcastle city-centre extraction area for TYNE CITY.
notes: Provisional core includes central Newcastle around Monument, Grey Street, Haymarket and Central Station, plus Quayside and the Tyne Bridge approach.
The bounding box includes the Tyne Bridge crossing and may include a limited area around its Gateshead landing; it is not an attempt to model wider Gateshead in this first pass.
The boundary must be confirmed by the project owner before network extraction.
